entities.name: Aldon's Castle
entities.description: Castle in the Western Domains ruled by Aldon and his family.

entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: Ruler of the castle who retook it with his allies.

entities.name: Serra Angels
entities.description: Allies of Aldon who helped retake the castle.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell after which Aldon's rule began.

events.summary: The wizard Dreygar overtakes the castle and sends Aldon into hiding.
events.quote: The wizard Dreygar overtook the castle and sent Aldon into hiding

events.summary: Aldon, with Serra Angels, a vampire, a bog wraith and a frozen shade, retakes the castle.
events.quote: Aldon, with the aid of his Serra Angels , vampire , bog wraith , and frozen shade , retook the castle

relations.note: Dreygar seized his castle and Aldon retook it.
relations.quote: The wizard Dreygar overtook the castle and sent Aldon into hiding
